licence.name: 小型車普通駕駛執照 (ordinary small-car driving licence)

note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Ministry of Justice's Laws & Regulations Database (law.moj.gov.tw): the Road Traffic Safety Rules (道路交通安全規則, as last amended 26 June 2026). Art. 60: an applicant for an ordinary driving licence must be at least 18 (with three months' learning for a small car), the age held. Art. 52: from 1 July 2013 ordinary licences no longer had to be renewed every six years; from 1 July 2017 an ordinary licence was valid until the holder turned 75, and from 31 May 2026 (115 in the Republic's years) a newly issued ordinary licence is valid until the holder turns 70, then renewed to 75 and every three years after. The term runs to an age, not a number of years: the licence is held to 70 (untilAge) with no term in years (null); the renewal to 75 and the three-yearly ones after aren't held. The licence fee is set in the highway authorities' fee standard, which wasn't found on the database, so the fee is null. No identity card is held, and no exchange list was read.

sources.title: 道路交通安全規則 (Road Traffic Safety Rules), Laws & Regulations Database of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
sources.said: 申請汽車駕駛執照考驗者，應具有下列資格： ... （一）考領普通駕駛執照、輕型或普通重型機車駕駛執照須年滿十八歲，最高年齡不受限制。 ... 自中華民國一百十五年五月三十一日起，新領或未滿七十歲駕駛人已領有之普通駕駛執照有效期間至年滿七十歲止，其後應依規定換發有效期間至七十五歲之駕駛執照
